ONE plain white sheet of light paper lies flat on table close to window. A cream curtain billows gently INWARD from breeze through the open window. All his hands away from paper. Paper not flying yet, no fan. Window opening, moving curtain, lone sheet and observer all clearly visible in one scene. No arrows or visible wind lines. Use case: illustration-story.
